item.title: Deleon Guerrero condemns federal decision to end funding for minority-serving institutions
item.description: (Press Release) — Galvin Sablan Deleon Guerrero, independent candidate for CNMI delegate to Congress and longtime educator, today condemned recent federal action to end discretionary funding for Minority-Serving Institutions, a move that he said undermines educational opportunity for students across the United States and the Pacific. The post Deleon Guerrero condemns federal decision to end funding for minority-serving institutions appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Governor honors 500 Sails founders
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang thanked 500 Sails’ Pete and Emma Perez for their dedication, encouragement, vision, and care for the CNMI and its people. The post Governor honors 500 Sails founders appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: 500 Sails welcomes 11th canoe to community fleet
item.description: 500 Sails and the Indigenous Affairs Office held a blessing and launching ceremony Saturday morning at Guma Sakman in Susupe for the newest addition to the nonprofit’s growing canoe fleet — a 14.3-foot galaide named Ka’isa. The post 500 Sails welcomes 11th canoe to community fleet appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Governor vetoes Rota tax bill
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang vetoed House Local Bill 24-14, which seeks to impose a 0.5% ad valorem local excise surtax on imported construction materials brought by contractors in Rota. The post Governor vetoes Rota tax bill appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Judge throws out refiled assault case against DPS officer
item.description: THE Superior Court on Dec. 19 dismissed a refiled felony assault charge against suspended Department of Public Safety Officer Troy Anthony Taman Manahane, ruling that prosecutors improperly revived a criminal offense that had already been dismissed after a preliminary hearing. The post Judge throws out refiled assault case against DPS officer appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Two charged in Northern Islands mayor’s office break-in
item.description: KEENE Deleon Guerrero and Nieves Lizama are accused of burglarizing the Northern Islands Mayor’s Office last week and taking Starlink packages, a satellite phone, a rifle, and other items valued at $2,761. The post Two charged in Northern Islands mayor’s office break-in appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Lt. gov. seeks dismissal of misconduct charges
item.description: LIEUTENANT Gov. Dennis Mendiola has asked the Superior Court to dismiss three counts of misconduct in public office against him, arguing that the Commonwealth’s charging document fails to define what constitutes an “illegal act.” The post Lt. gov. seeks dismissal of misconduct charges appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Hotels struggle as occupancy hits historic low
item.description: (HANMI) — The Hotel Association of the Northern Mariana Islands reported 17% average occupancy rate among 11 member hotels for November 2025, 37% lower than 27.45% in November 2024 and the lowest occupancy rate ever recorded by the association, excluding November 2020 at the height of the coronavirus pandemic. The post Hotels struggle as occupancy hits historic low appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Casa Marianas opens, aims to boost local digital economy
item.description: THE opening of Casa Marianas last week will help diversify the CNMI economy, the company said. The post Casa Marianas opens, aims to boost local digital economy appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Revised budget bill heads to governor
item.description: THE House of Representatives and the Senate held back-to-back sessions on Monday to pass the revised fiscal year 2026 budget bill, which appropriates $138.9 million for government operations and personnel. The post Revised budget bill heads to governor appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
